layout_rules.encoding: GLB2 raw layout, zstd level 3, 8-byte header; M31 metadata and 100-row request sequences
layout_rules.placement: clusters in cluster_id order or a greedy nearest-centroid chain from cluster 0; a cluster that does not fit the open pack starts a new pack

query_rules.ranges: one range per pack; a later extent in the same pack widens it and is charged the gap; rerank only the chosen blocks' rows, exact f64 with ID ties after deduplication
query_rules.ranked_blocks: blocks of the nearest `probes` postings in (nearest-row exact distance, block) order; skip a block that exceeds a cap and continue
query_rules.whole_postings: postings in (centroid score, cluster ID) order; stop at the first that exceeds the request or byte cap

training.sample_rule: keep the sample_rows smallest (ivf::sample_priority(seed, ID), ID); initial centers are the first centroids sample rows in that order
